title: Staff Distributed Systems Engineer - Storage Infrastructure
description:
We are seeking a Staff Distributed Systems Engineer to scale our transactional database infrastructure. You will design, implement, and operate foundational storage systems that power global payment settlement with five-nines reliability.

Responsibilities:
- Architect distributed consensus, replication, and storage engines using Go, Rust, or C++.
- Ensure zero data loss and automated failover across multi-region datacenters.
- Optimize p99 tail latency for database transactions handling billions of dollars daily.
- Mentor senior engineers and drive architectural roadmaps across the engineering organization.

Qualifications:
- 8+ years experience building distributed storage, consensus (Raft/Paxos), or transaction processing systems.
- Deep familiarity with Linux systems internals, memory models, and networking performance.
- Strong proficiency in Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node.js.

title: Principal Platform & Edge Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Join our Core Platform team to architect the next generation of our global edge computing runtime. You will build high-performance distributed caching, traffic steering, and resilience primitives deployed across 300+ edge points of presence.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design scalable traffic routing protocols and resilient distributed caches.
- Develop eBPF and kernel-level network telemetry modules.
- Build robust automation to self-heal edge server partitions.

Requirements:
- 9+ years engineering high-concurrency network servers or edge platforms.
- Advanced experience with Go, Rust, or TypeScript.
- Expertise in Linux networking stack and distributed observability (Prometheus/Grafana).

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Real-Time Collaboration Engine
description:
Figma is looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join our Real-Time Infrastructure team. You will lead technical design on our multi-player synchronization servers, conflict resolution algorithms, and distributed state storage engines.

What You'll Do:
- Scale our operational transform and CRDT engines supporting millions of simultaneous canvas editors.
- Optimize WebSockets and HTTP/2 protocol servers for low-latency state broadcast.
- Partner with product engineers to guarantee document persistence with zero data loss.

Requirements:
- 7+ years backend engineering experience with high-scale distributed systems.
- Proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, Go, or Rust.
- Strong grounding in database transactional concurrency, SQLite, and PostgreSQL.
